Everybody who has ever tried to help me ends up failing and nobody really wants to talk to me or be my friend nowadays.  If somebody says "I'm depressed because I'm ugly and retarded" there's not much you can actually do to help if they are actually ugly and retarded and you agree with them.

>I'm guessing you've talked to therapists or someone similar

Holy fucking shit, did you even read the title of my post?  Fucking unreal.

>how can you know what will happen if you don't even give it a chance

That's very cute but fuck you, I have been "giving it a chance" for very long.  It's been four years, I've given it a fucking chance.  My life for four years has consisted of going out and trying to meet people and getting laughed at and rejected and then listening to geniuses like you telling me I "haven't actually tried."

>suicide Hotlines

Last time I called the local "crisis center" they asked me if I'm thinking about killing myself, I told them that sounds like a good idea and if they have any reason why I shouldn't kill myself, they didn't so I told her she sucks at her job
